slides.text: terracotta and moss feel like home
slides.look: A cognac leather sofa topped with olive velvet throw pillows, a rust-toned vintage kilim rug, a walnut coffee table stacked with art books, a brass arched floor lamp, and a tall fiddle leaf fig in a ceramic pot.

slides.text: electric cobalt wakes up the entire room
slides.look: A cobalt blue corduroy sofa with mustard fringe cushions, a bold checkered wool rug in saffron and cream, a chrome tubular coffee table, an oversized abstract primary art print, and a sculptural mushroom lamp.

slides.text: deep plum and emerald add instant drama
slides.look: A deep emerald velvet sectional piled with aubergine and plum cushions, a moody botanical flatweave rug, a smoked glass coffee table with brass accents, amber glass table lamps, and a dramatic arched gilded floor mirror.

slides.text: warm peach softens everything without being boring
slides.look: A curved dusty peach bouclé couch with marigold linen pillows, an ochre geometric Berber rug, a travertine round coffee table, layered warm canvas artwork in timber frames, and a glowing pleated fabric table lamp.

slides.text: burgundy stripes bring cozy library energy
slides.look: A tailored sage green linen sofa with burgundy ticking stripe pillows, a faded Persian runner layered over woven jute, dark oak side tables, brass task lamps, and framed vintage botanical sketches.

slides.text: lilac and butter yellow are so cheerful
slides.look: A butter yellow curved sofa paired with lilac linen throw cushions, an undulating wavy green wool rug, a glossy red lacquer accent side table, whimsical ceramic vases, and a polished aluminum table lamp.

plan.cta_look: A caramel velvet settee with cerulean silk pillows, a rich Turkish medallion rug, a burl wood coffee table holding glossy design monographs, a fluted marble lamp, and leafy monsteras in terracotta planters.
